summary: Ground recognized measurement units to cited numbers, bounded properties and exact workflow identities.
decision_refs: The active goal requires continued RFI, Submittal and Email accuracy and adaptability
The user previously required dimensions, design properties and quantities to remain explicit and readable
An offline reproduction proved a same-RFI pipe-diameter versus insulation-thickness unit false acceptance
approval_evidence: The persistent objective authorizes deterministic answer-accuracy improvements across RFI, Submittal and Email content.
known_limitations: Only the documented bounded unit vocabulary is normalized; unknown and bare ambiguous unit tokens are not interpreted.
Allowlisted alphabetic units may touch their number, but arbitrary alphanumeric tokens and unsupported compound units remain uninterpreted.
Formatting equivalents normalize only within the same unit family and no physical conversion is performed.
The guard does not calculate values, infer arbitrary engineering properties or decide which document controls.
The guard does not prove that every relevant project document was uploaded or parsed.
